note: Single source of truth for the storefront catalog. The wp-setup job seeds by SKU and never overwrites admin edits unless STORE_SEED_FORCE=1. The image generator (scripts/gen-store-images.py) leaves existing <sku>.png files alone so the owner can drop in better photos without code changes.
